shapeSummary: Simplified 72 mm diameter, 24 mm wide wheel with a 12 mm central through-bore. The axis of rotation is along Z, centered at X=0 and Z=0. The wheel is shifted so its lowest point is at Y=0, with its center at Y=36. It is a solid disc with the bore only, because the spoked hub, tread grooves and bolt holes are omitted.
warnings: Only the 72 mm diameter is stated. The 24 mm width and 12 mm bore are visual estimates and need checking against the vendor drawing.
The open spoked hub pockets, the recessed hub face and the tread lugs and grooves are omitted because their geometry is uncertain.
The bolt-circle holes are visible, but their diameter and positions are not given, so they are omitted.
The rubber tread and plastic core are modeled as a single solid.
The analysis puts the axis along Z, so the wheel stands on its rim at Y=0. This follows the bounds in the analysis, not the flat orientation in the photo.
